ops.reason: neck: a second loop between N1 and N2 so the S-bend has three rings to deform
chest base of the neck: a loop between B3 and N1 so the neck root bends without collapsing
wing finger: a knuckle loop halfway along the long spar (its quads were needles)
wing finger tip: a loop halfway to the tip (needle quads, and the tip flexes)
tail tip: a loop halfway along the last tail segment (needle quads; the tip flicks)
eye socket on the skull side under the brow
